title: An Exact Dual for Second-Order Cone Programming Using Only Lorentz-Cone Constraints
summary: Without a constraint qualification, second-order cone programs can have a duality gap or an unattained dual value. For every such program with arbitrary real coefficients, we construct an exact dual using only affine equations and memberships in products of Lorentz cones. Every feasible dual point gives a valid bound. Whenever the primal is feasible with finite value, the dual attains that value.
